tickets.title: Keep the world size per Parallax_Heart, not in Gvars_Parallax statics
tickets.detail:
Request from LaChasseGalerie (d1/r9 there). Not blocking: the game works on 2.1.0 today.

The game draws a page IN FRONT of its sprites by using two Parallax_Hearts (background + foreground) that share one camera and batch (LaChasseGalerie core/src/jks/parralax/GVars_Parralax.java). The 2019 snapshot it replaced had a built-in second page; two hearts made that unnecessary, so nothing else was missing.

The fragile part: every Parallax_Heart constructor calls Gvars_Parallax.setWorldWidth/Height, and ParallaxLayer.resetPosition/setDecalPercentX/Y read Gvars_Parallax.getWidthPercent/getHeightPercent. The world size is one static for the whole JVM. Two hearts only work while they are built with the same size; a second heart with another size, or resize() on a heart that owns its batch, silently moves the decal_X/Y of every other heart's layers.

Ask: store worldWidth/worldHeight on the heart (or the page reader) and pass them to the layers, keeping the static getters as a default for single-heart games. Check: two hearts with different world sizes in one app keep their own decal placement.
Note (fedora1-parallax-10): Read the code. Statics are read in 3 places: ParallaxLayer decal math (resetPosition, setDecalPercentX/Y, get/setScrollX/Y), WholePage_Model.useAtlas (layer width AND the decal applied by setUpEverything at build), and the reader's addLayersTransfert via pageModel.getDrawing(). So a transfert page is built lazily with whatever size the last-built heart left in the st

Note .plaxpj is the editor's Jackson JSON, not the Kryo .plax format, and preload already accepts a path in atlasName ('../Demos/OneNight.atlas' would load) - so a relative/absolute atlas path in the PROJECT file needs no .plax format bump, as long as the export keeps the bare nam
